shared_or_similar_visual_information: Two raised interval traces with circular boundary marks on a number line. Compare the traces attached to the marks at 1 and 4 in the left image with the traces attached to the marks at −3 and 4 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The strict traces overlap for values between 1 and 4. Right image: The two strict traces share the inputs −3 < x < 4.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image admits the middle interval in both traces. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
